scope: 15 saved Natural Scene splits; published LDL scoring cores under the frozen cost-feasibility protocol

methods.GBFRS k: exact fuzzy-rough LDL dependency (Qian et al. 2023 core), forward greedy to matched k
methods.GBFRS budget: same criterion, positive-gain/cost greedy within the Joint guard budget
methods.DSIM k: dual-similarity dependence (Deng et al. 2022 core), top-k by score
methods.FSLC k: feature-similarity/label-correlation greedy (Qian et al. 2022 core), matched k
methods.FSLC budget: relevance-per-cost with redundancy penalty, within budget

fairness: k and cost budget are Joint guard outputs determined by training only. Same predictor, folds, normalization and costs as baselines/. Training-only statistics; selections saved before test evaluation. Implementations of cited scoring cores under a unified protocol, not verbatim replicas of published pipelines.
note: GBFRS uses exact fuzzy lower approximations (strengthening of the ball-level approximation); bandwidths are per-attribute training standard deviations of min-max normalized features.
